name: Ink illustration (boiling pen lines, hatching, paper)
what: Redraws any three.js scene as a hand-inked illustration: outlines from depth and normal breaks that boil (re-drawn 7 times a second) with uneven pen pressure, screen-space hatching and cross-hatching in the shadows, paper grain and vignette, plus hurt ink-bleed, flash and desaturate. Comes with three-tone toon materials and a palette module that cross-fades the whole world's colours, ink and hatch level between sets (levels, time of day).
use_when: the game wants a hand-drawn, pen-and-ink, comic, sketchbook or illustrated look, or its world colours and time of day should cross-fade between levels.
good_for: First- or third-person 3D games that should look drawn, not rendered: simple lit shapes become an illustration with no textures; levels that change mood (dawn to night) with one palette blend.
not_for: Photoreal or painterly looks (use oil-paint or watercolour), pixel art, orthographic 2D games, or very weak GPUs (the scene is drawn twice per frame).
how_to_add: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-ink-illustration, then route the starter's draw through ink.render(scene, camera, dt) (HOW-TO-USE.md, 'Drop it into the starter') and build materials with inkToon().
